notes.title: I WILL BE THERE is Released on STEAM!
notes.content:
Hello gamers and friends!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1513910/

The next game I have been working on for two years, I WILL BE THERE, is finally released on STEAM! Right now it has a 10% launch discount, and it is discounted even more if you buy the Soundtrack Edition!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30101/

It is a unique 'Survival-Adventure' game with visual novel aestethics and role-playing elements, about a lonely man with an RV in a zombie-infested world.

Enjoy the journey!

notes.title: Epics Of Distant Realm 2 !!!
notes.content:
Epics Of Distant Realm: Holy Return is a Turn-Based Combat and Story Sci-Fi game that delves into the mythologies of the universe, the terminal of the universe, the Planet of Destiny.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833300/Epics_of_Distant_Realm_Holy_Return/

notes.title: Update #1: Assault Rifle!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34100524/a508a5dbce05e32493a6f8fefafaf0c4128c71b4.jpg[/img]

You know what they say: Never bring a knife to a gunfight.

Well, you can do vice versa. The new update lets you wield an assault rifle and do some serious damage with it... that is, if you can find ammunition.

Buy now, get the 10% discount and bring a gun to a sword fight.

[h1]What's new:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Introduction of the assault rifle
[*] New level up system
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

Hello distant realm warriors! The game is now available on Steam, with a 10% launch discount. To get a greater discount, you can buy the bundle on the store page, where you can also get The Orphan Dreams!

notes.title: Incoming Official Launch
notes.content:
Hello, wanderers of distant galaxies! I would like to give an insight into the launch by the 4th of January.

The initial launch will bring you the authentic look and feel of Epics of Distant Realm you know from 2006. Then, by each update, new content will be added. 

Hop on the train early and your comments and suggestions will be taken into consideration, and you may contribute to the future development!
